description: C18 — 法国防御温洩变例，双翼竞速最激烈形式

intro.popup_en:
Pawn-Chain Direction, Practice 6
The French Winawer becomes a race on opposite wings. ...Bb4 pins Nc3 and can leave doubled c-pawns, but White's pawn chain remains intact. White attacks kingside while Black targets the queenside: whose attack arrives first?
intro.popup:
兵链方向练习6
温洩变例——最激烈双翼竞速！
Bb4钉住Nc3
→c3叠兵是弱点
→但白方兵链完整！
白攻g侧，黑攻c侧
谁先到达对方的王？

outro.popup_en: Summary: Bxg4 opens the position and intensifies the fight between Black's queenside attack and White's kingside defense. Nd8 reroutes the knight, Nf7 probes, and g3 blocks it, leaving White with the better position.
outro.popup:
总结：Bxg4开放局面 → 后翼进攻与王翼防守激烈对抗
Nd8调整マ！Nf7刺探！g3封锁 → 白方位置优势

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4 is the Winawer Variation, pinning Nc3.
e5! White establishes the French pawn chain while Nc3 is pinned by ...Bb4.
moves.popup:
e5！温洩兵链形成！Bb4钉住Nc3
白e5推进建立兵链

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black immediately attacks the base of White's pawn chain.
a3! White challenges the bishop and accepts doubled pawns in exchange for preserving the pawn chain. This is a strategic trade-off.
moves.popup:
a3！逼兑！白接受双叠兵
换取兵链完整——战略交换！

moves.popup_en: bxc3 leaves White with doubled pawns, but the pawn chain remains intact.
...c4 expands on the queenside.
Re1 activates White's rooks.
...h5 begins Black's kingside counterplay.
Nd2 reroutes the knight in preparation for the f5 advance.
...g5 expands on the kingside and starts a direct attack.
Ne3 reroutes White's knight toward the kingside.
...O-O-O! Black castles long, beginning the queenside race.
Bxh5 wins the pawn on h5.
...g4! Black pushes the g-pawn aggressively.
Bxg4! White's bishop captures the pawn and opens the position. The opposite-wing race now shifts into a phase of exchanges and defensive coordination.
moves.popup:
Bxg4！白象取g4，开放局面
双翼竞速进入消耗阶段

moves.popup_en: ...f5 advances another pawn to support Black's attack.
moves.popup:
f5！黑方推进f兵
进一步激活后翼进攻路线

moves.popup_en: Bh5 retreats while maintaining pressure on f7.
...Be8 retreats the bishop and prepares to simplify.
moves.popup: Be8！黑方象撤退保护，准备简化

moves.popup_en: Bxe8 removes Black's bishop and simplifies the position.
...Rdxe8 recaptures with the rook and takes control of the e-file.
Nf1 reroutes White's knight toward the kingside.
moves.popup: Nf1！白马重新调整，准备转向王翼

moves.popup_en: ...Rhg8 places the rook on the g-file for counterplay.
f4 reinforces White's e5-pawn chain and blocks Black's attacking routes.
moves.popup: f4！白方巩固e5兵链，封锁黑方进攻通道

moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 jumps to an active square and attacks f4.
Re2 coordinates the rooks defensively and prevents Black's invasion.
moves.popup: Re2！车集中守备，防止黑车入侵

moves.popup_en: ...Nd8 reroutes the knight and clears c6 for Black's rook.
moves.popup:
Nd8！马撤退d8，准备重新调整路线
为黑车让出c6格

moves.popup_en: Rf2 coordinates the rooks and increases pressure along the f-file.
moves.popup: Rf2！双车联动，加强f路线压力

moves.popup_en: ...Qh7 places the queen on the kingside and applies pressure there.
a4 expands on the queenside and discourages Black's ...b5 break.
moves.popup:
a4！白方后翼扩展
封锁黑方b5反击可能

moves.popup_en: ...Nf7 probes White's defenses and threatens e5.
moves.popup:
Nf7！黑马刺探f7！
威胁e5并试探白方防守

moves.popup_en: Qe2 activates the queen, controls the e-file, and supports the center.
moves.popup: Qe2！白后活跃，控制e线 同时支持中心防守

moves.popup_en: ...Nh4 threatens g2 and f3.
g3! White blocks the knight on h4 and consolidates the kingside. White's position is now clearly more comfortable.
moves.popup:
g3！白方封锁Nh4！
兵形巩固，白方阵地优势明显
双翼竞速下白方最终占据上风！
